description: A pristine, high-contrast Light theme paired with Deep Navy (Al Azhar brand) and subtle glowing cyan accents. Blends the authoritative feel of an educational institution with an advanced, futuristic tech-asset dashboard.

headings.usage: Used for all dashboard titles, chart headers, and token-entry screens. Must be tightly tracked (tracking-tight).

body.usage: Highly legible, geometric sans for data tables, form inputs, and UI text.

mono.usage: Used for serial numbers, token codes, and data specific metrics.

rules: Use tracking-[0.1em] for small uppercase labels (Overlines).
Use #0A192F for the admin login screen or hero background to establish authority.
For the futuristic dashboard vibe on a light theme, use white cards with very subtle slate borders (border-slate-200) and sharp shadow (shadow-sm).
Accentuate key metrics and token inputs with Cyan/Blue glow effects (ring-cyan-400/50).

surfaces: The 'Crystal' Variant (Glassmorphism): Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border border-white/40 for floating headers and sticky navs. NO purely transparent overlays.

The 'Grid' Variant: Expose the structural skeleton on the main public dashboard using border-collapse styles (border-r border-b border-slate-200) for bento grid items to look highly technical and futuristic.
shadows: Use crisp, subtle layered shadows: shadow-[0_2px_10px_rgba(0,45,98,0.08)] for cards.
borders: Max border radius 12px (rounded-xl). Keep it slightly sharp rather than overly bubbly.

items: Hero Stat (Total iPads): col-span-12 md:col-span-4 row-span-2
Lungsuran Traces (Timeline list): col-span-12 md:col-span-4 row-span-3

components.charts: recharts (for distribution by series/storage and year)
components.forms: react-hook-form + zod (for admin panel and pakta form)

specific_features.name: Digital Signature
specific_features.usage: Used inside the Token-gated Pakta form for teachers to physically sign.

specific_features.name: PDF Export
specific_features.usage: Generate F4 size PDF (210 x 330 mm) for the signed Pakta. Convert HTML to canvas, inject into jsPDF set to 'f4' dimensions.

specific_features.name: Lungsuran Trace Visualization
specific_features.usage: Custom vertical timeline component. Use a left-bordered div with relative dots to show the chain of custody for a specific iPad serial number (e.g., Senior Teacher 2023 -> New Teacher 2024).

specific_features.name: Token Input Form
specific_features.usage: A highly stylized, centered 6-digit OTP-style input (or short text input) that reveals the specific teacher's pre-filled Pakta data.

motion.transitions: transition-all duration-300 ease-out (avoid 'all' on transforms, explicitly declare properties).
motion.hover: Subtle -translate-y-1 and ring-2 ring-brand-navy/20 on interactive cards.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for dashboard grid items using framer-motion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA/WCAG AA standards. Navy text on white backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-pakta-btn', data-testid='token-input').

hero_background.description: Modern school architecture, used with a heavy navy overlay for the admin login background.

feature_ipad.description: Modern iPad on a desk, used in the public dashboard header or empty states.

teacher_profile_placeholder.description: Teacher using a tablet, useful for the Pakta success screen.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Hybrid Fullstack app using React (JS) + FastAPI.
Public Dashboard (Route: /) must display charts using Recharts: iPad models, storage sizes, and lungsuran chains without requiring login.
Admin Area (Route: /admin) requires standard login. Admins can manage units, assign them, and generate token codes.
Pakta Entry (Route: /pakta) is a token-gated screen. The user enters their unique code, sees their pre-filled data, signs via react-signature-canvas, and submits.
PDF generation must strictly map to F4 size (210mm x 330mm). Use jspdf formatting { format: [210, 330] }.
No TSX files. Write purely in modern Javascript (.jsx / .js).
Use standard Tailwind classes. Do not create custom CSS unless absolutely necessary.
Ensure 'Al Azhar International Islamic Boarding School' navy branding feels central and official, not like a generic SaaS template.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not use generic centered layouts or uniform styling. Prioritize optical alignment and tension.
Create depth through layered design elements (z-index hierarchy).
Use glass-morphism effects (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) but never purely transparent overlays.
Never apply 'transition: all'. Explicitly state transition properties.
Never center-align the main app container. Let content flow naturally.
Avoid emoji characters for icons; rely strictly on lucide-react.
Use 2-3x more spacing than usual for a premium feel (e.g., p-8 instead of p-4).
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
